topics.title: John Johnson and the Jessica Hahn Special - Radio Chaos
topics.summary: During an interview, John Johnson attempts to arrange a special program with Jessica Hahn while Steve recounts his producer experience at Westgate Productions. Gilbert Gottfried shares his journey into comedy after seeing Steve’s work and reveals he was initially studying brain surgery before pursuing stand-up.

topics.title: Stern Radio’s Gary and Melissa Mishap
topics.summary: During the show, Howard Stern engages in chaotic banter involving Melissa Gilbert and frequent phone calls from listeners. The conversation devolves into an absurd critique of listener Gary's dating life – including his ex-girlfriend, dental issues, and attempts to ‘warm up’ callers - punctuated by a lengthy discussion about the show itself and repeated critiques of overly enthusiastic laughter.

topics.title: Joan Kennedy and Eric the Counselor
topics.summary: During a radio discussion, it was revealed that Joan Kennedy had an affair with alcoholism counselor Eric. Their relationship ended when he became discouraged by her shame and reluctance to introduce him to her social circle, leading to her relapse into drinking.

topics.title: Marital Disputes & Outer Space Advice
topics.summary: During a chaotic radio show, Joe Walsh, Rick (the bass player), and Lisa discuss marital problems including accusations of payola and inappropriate behavior. Rick offers bizarre advice about outer space – never urinate in it!—while grappling with his attraction to Lisa and navigating the band’s complicated dynamics.

topics.title: Joe Walsh’s Unconventional Marriage Revelations
topics.summary: During a radio interview, Joe Walsh recounts his long-term marriage to Lisa, detailing their unconventional relationship marked by multiple short-lived affairs and unusual habits. He describes her as difficult but alluring, involving extended periods of separation, frequent vomiting from his son Rick, and bizarre behaviors like using condoms infrequently.
